Implemented four owned files: `runtime.py`, `campaign.py`, `test_runtime.py`, `README.md`.

Input revision: `4ea4af17727020bac2ba8f5e2f6172378711c15a`. Frozen helpers unchanged; no commits or dependency modifications.

Verified:

- 9 focused tests pass.
- Eight 2-event native smokes pass: four Fatras-muon pitches and 0.5/2 mm SafeFatras-electron/Geant4-electron cases.
- Baseline equivalence and all immutability gates pass.
- Geant4 maps all 46,250 sensors exactly and processes two events per case.
- Native environment: Python 3.14.5, ROOT 6.40.04, Geant4 11.4.3.
- Session validation passes: 217 records.

Evidence: `/private/tmp/nodd-strixel-gbts/smoke-v2`.

Production command after parent source freeze:

```sh
source software/env/truth_tracking.sh
python -B software/analysis/strixel_reconstruction/campaign.py launch \
  --output build/strixel-gbts-production --jobs 3
```

Use identical arguments with `check` or `resume`. Scheduling starts expensive cases first using hashed frozen timing references. `hits.root` and full audit are mandatory; `--write-root` adds summaries.

Cautions: persisted hit floats are float32; independent pairing remains required. Historical Geant4-electron 100 GeV timing suggests roughly 20 minutes per 1,000-event case before contention.

limitations: Only userMessage and agentMessage text retained; reasoning, tool arguments/results and private state excluded.
Conservative path, credential, email and URL redaction is not a privacy guarantee; review retained text.
Exposed operation counts are per retained turn; journal counts can describe the same invocations and must not be added.
Peer/parent contact operations are not child-spawn evidence and are excluded from the subagents list; operation counts remain retained. Child relationships use verified root spawn metadata.
